answer: Option B was rejected because its core assumption that cross-region replay preserves write order was invalidated by direct trials. Trial b-01 and b-02 failed the write-order check, and checksums diverged (b-01: 1284 records; b-clean: 1317). The intermediate checkpoint-14 recommendation preferred B as simpler/faster but was superseded once this assumption failed (event evt-final-option-b-rejected cites replay-order and checksum-divergence). Option C (dual-write with verified replay) passed trials c-01/c-02/c-03 and satisfied write-order and checksum-parity, so it was selected. Staging pass and bandwidth success did not address replay ordering. Still-valid constraints: no destructive cutover, checksum parity required, and a 30-minute rollback window.
